name: Instagram Feed Post
strategic_objective: Visual storytelling, brand positioning, education, and engagement through static or swipeable content.

tone: Inspirational, aspirational, and conversational. Native, human, and visually driven.
copywriting_rules: Front-load the hook or key value in the first line due to caption truncation. Use short, scannable paragraphs. Let the visual do part of the storytelling and use the caption to add meaning, context, or structure.
Line 1: hook, promise, or tension. Lines 2–4: context, story, or explanation. Final line: clear and specific CTA.
Mix niche, topic-based, and brand hashtags. Avoid generic or high-noise tags.
Tag people, brands, or collaborators only when they are directly relevant and visible in the content.

required_generation_elements: Hook in the first line of the caption
Visual that clearly communicates the main idea
hard_constraints: Misleading hooks that do not match the visual
